description: The bar chart illustrates the performance gain (+%) achieved by VisuoThink through predictive rollout search across three different models: GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL. The vertical axis represents the performance gain in percentage, ranging from 0 to 30, while the horizontal axis lists the models. Two types of supervision are compared: "Strong Supervision" (striped bars) and "Weak Supervision" (solid bars). For GPT-4o, the performance gain under strong supervision is approximately 25%, while under weak supervision it is around 6%. For Claude-3.5-Sonnet, the gain is about 10% under strong supervision and 4% under weak supervision. For Qwen2-72B-VL, the gain is approximately 15% under strong supervision and 6% under weak supervision. The chart shows that strong supervision consistently yields higher performance gains than weak supervision across all models.
